name: Nexity S.A.
summary: Nexity S.A., a real estate powerhouse established in 1995 and headquartered in Paris, France, boasts a significant presence across Europe and internationally. The company organizes its extensive operations into three primary divisions: Development, Services, and Other Activities. In its Development segment, Nexity is responsible for creating new residential properties, including individual homes and entire subdivisions. It also constructs and renovates a broad spectrum of commercial and industrial real estate, such as office towers, high-rise buildings, business parks, logistics centers, retail establishments, hotels, and various other industrial facilities. The Services division delivers a wide array of property-related offerings. These include comprehensive property management (covering rental administration, sales and leasing, and co-ownership oversight), the operation of specialized residences for both students and seniors, and the distribution of real estate products under the iSelection and PERL brands. Additionally, this segment provides real estate brokerage and space planning consultancy. Beyond these core areas, Nexity engages in broader urban development initiatives, including pre-development work on urban regeneration projects, various investment activities, and the incubation of new startups. The company serves a diverse clientele, encompassing private individuals, corporate entities, institutional investors, and local governmental bodies.
